O.outcome_detail: team post-activity anatomy knowledge test score

cells.quote: The results indicate that higher JVA was positively associated with student learning outcomes (𝑟(30) = 0.50, 𝑝 < 0.005).
cells.note: Measured association between automatically extracted joint visual attention and team post-test performance; no treatment was manipulated for this finding.

O.outcome_detail: automatically computed joint visual attention ratio

cells.quote: Although no significant difference between the three study conditions and the JVA ratio was observed, the p-value was very close to the critical value  of α (𝐹(2,27) = 3.26, 𝑝 = 0.054, 𝑛𝑠—𝑛𝑠 stands for statistically non -significant).
cells.note: The study reports three between-subjects conditions; random assignment to conditions is not stated.

O.outcome_detail: team JVA ratio during the collaborative activity

cells.quote: Interestingly, the JVA ratio of two experimental groups of tablet and AR (𝑛 = 20, 𝑀 = 45.6, 𝑆𝐷 = 15.97) was significantly higher than those in the control condition who used textbook (𝑛 = 10, 𝑀 = 31.3, 𝑆𝐷 = 9.73), and this finding was statistically significant with a large effect size  (𝐹(1,28) = 6.65, 𝑝 < 0.05, 𝐶𝑜ℎ𝑒𝑛′𝑠 𝑑 = 1.00 (Cohen, 2013) ).
cells.note: The experimental condition combines the tablet and screen-based AR groups.

O.outcome_detail: team average post-activity test identifying five muscle names

cells.quote: Similarly, the team’s average post-test score from two experimental groups of tablet and AR (𝑀 = 2.35, 𝑆𝐷 = 1.20) was significantly higher  than those in the control group (𝑀 = 1.15, 𝑆𝐷 = 0.95), and this finding was statistically significant with a large effect size (𝐹(1,28) = 7.56, 𝑝 < 0.05, 𝐶𝑜ℎ𝑒𝑛′𝑠 𝑑 = 1.06).
cells.note: The study describes this as knowledge retention, but the post-test occurred after the activity and no day-or-more delay is reported.

O.outcome_detail: student learning outcomes measured by post-activity knowledge test

cells.quote: The results indicate that higher JVA was positively associated with student learning outcomes (𝑟(30) = 0.50, 𝑝 < 0.005).
cells.note: This is a measured association between JVA and learning outcomes, not a manipulated treatment contrast.
